summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The LionShares U.S. Equity Total Return ETF (TOT) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is actively managed, seeking long-term capital growth through investments in ETFs that track the broad US equity market. The fund aims to minimize taxable distributions. TOT was launched on Sep 3, 2025 and is issued by LionShares.
